title: Synthetic workflow checklist routing fixture
text: SYNTHETIC WORKFLOW FIXTURE ONLY — no cohort data and no clinical rule. This text is present to test retrieval vocabulary for cfDNA ctDNA MRD, CHIP, matched WBC and buffy coat, germline, assay limit of detection (LOD), low VAF, tumor-informed context, serial longitudinal sampling, persistence, clearance, recurrence, relapse, artifacts, confounders, resistance, targeted therapy, trial eligibility, uncertainty, caller, source tracing, and expert checklist routing. It does not state a medical recommendation.
